p0_1_baseline.inputs: instrument_boundary; predecessor mission statuses; live build stamp; VITRUVIUS v1.1; frozen target and Nous/Mastra evidence
p0_1_baseline.c1: Manifest pins target source/build, instrument hash and BOTH Nous and Mastra stimulus packs; production and local source are distinguished.
p0_1_baseline.cmd1: git rev-parse HEAD; gh run list --branch main --limit 1 --json headSha,conclusion; R-MACHINE; manual: compare each pack identity.
p0_1_baseline.red1: Replace one scorer stimulus build hash: reconciliation must refuse a comparable baseline.
p0_1_baseline.c2: Two isolated scorers independently score target, Nous and Mastra against the same v1.1 clauses; every dimension has evidence/ceiling and disagreements retain both sheets.
p0_1_baseline.cmd2: Manual protocol: give each scorer the same sealed evidence pack and instrument only, no peer scores; reconcile clause by clause after both return. R-CAPTURE for missing visual evidence.
p0_1_baseline.red2: Remove a clause capture or use v1.0 for one exemplar: scorer must mark the clause unmeasured or the event incomparable.

p0_2_instruments.inputs: genesis census limitations; full tracked component population; reader_protocol; word_budgets; provider wrapper
p0_2_instruments.c1: Version each census population, exclusions, advisory/blocking semantics and provider hash; word overage is advisory, unsupported claims blocking.
p0_2_instruments.cmd1: R-TOKENS; node site/scripts/reading_census.mjs --selftest; manual: enumerate routes, headings and component extensions against the input manifest.
p0_2_instruments.red1: Drop a JSX component or omit a required route: coverage reconciliation must fail.
p0_2_instruments.c2: Every added detector rejects its isolated failing fixture and accepts a valid one; fresh-context reader prescreens and answer-key calibration are correctly labeled.
p0_2_instruments.cmd2: Manual protocol: reader_protocol synthetic/calibration sections; R-CAPTURE matrix controls; run each recorded instrument argv against positive and negative disposable fixtures.
p0_2_instruments.red2: Plant banned prose, an allowed quoted term, an over-target paragraph, wrong theme and token bypass separately; banned prose/bypass/missing matrix fail while word overage warns.

p1_1_homepage_voice.inputs: home source/twin; front_page_doctrine; existing primitive; word_budgets; reader_protocol
p1_1_homepage_voice.c1: Low-fidelity storyboard orders mechanism, working example, shared-cultural-heritage rationale and participation before visual production, with text/DOM reading order preserved.
p1_1_homepage_voice.cmd1: Manual: annotate four storyboard sections with source artifact and action; R-VOICE on /; R-CAPTURE on /.
p1_1_homepage_voice.red1: Remove the primitive or put an unsupported frontier-model claim in the storyboard: editorial review must reject it.
p1_1_homepage_voice.c2: Rendered home/twin agree, claims cite evidence, word-target exceptions are justified, and fresh-context synthetic reads record confusions before DP3 formative humans.
p1_1_homepage_voice.cmd2: R-SITE; R-VOICE /; reader_protocol synthetic prescreen; R-CAPTURE / including art-disabled reading.
p1_1_homepage_voice.red2: Conceal a required explanation in art or change only the HTML copy: text-equivalence/twin review must fail.

p1_2_quickstart_voice.c1: Every first task has exact command, prerequisites, expected result and recovery path in its rendered article and twin; explanation target overages have reasons.
p1_2_quickstart_voice.cmd1: R-VOICE on /get-started,/learn/what-is-adna; R-SOURCE for all tour routes from docs_population other_routes.
p1_2_quickstart_voice.red1: Remove a prerequisite from the rendered page while retaining it in source: instruction review must fail.
p1_2_quickstart_voice.c2: Copy the rendered executable string and reproduce the local first task in a disposable environment; distinguish automated reproduction from human TTFS.
p1_2_quickstart_voice.cmd2: R-SITE; manual: copy each first-task command from the preview and execute exactly in a clean disposable directory, recording argv/version/exit/output; never run publishing steps.
p1_2_quickstart_voice.red2: Alter a copy-button payload to a stale command in a disposable fixture: copied-string comparison must fail.

p1_3_mission_voice.inputs: /about,/community,/commons,/network; public-good doctrine; existing consent/embargo records; P1 storyboard
p1_3_mission_voice.c1: All four mission surfaces preserve Agentic DNA, opt-in sharing, current stewardship and aspiration/fact distinctions, with accessible heading order and evidence adjacency.
p1_3_mission_voice.cmd1: R-VOICE on /about,/community,/commons,/network; manual: map every revised institutional assertion to its exact clearance or held disposition.
p1_3_mission_voice.red1: Insert a false endorsement or imply mandatory sharing: claim review must fail.
p1_3_mission_voice.c2: Operator-supplied formative humans (at least one per decisive class) test the P1 candidate before DP3; every material confusion has correction or explicit gate disposition.
p1_3_mission_voice.cmd2: reader_protocol formative protocol; R-CAPTURE on the four routes; report each individual observation without an aggregate success percentage.
p1_3_mission_voice.red2: Relabel a synthetic response as human or omit a reader class: formative pack completeness review must reject it.

p2_1_proof_lineage.inputs: existing public standard and dev-vault example; related research/lineage citations; P1 candidate
p2_1_proof_lineage.c1: Worked example identifies pinned public inputs, mechanism, license and lineage, with unsupported novelty/evaluation statements removed or marked absent.
p2_1_proof_lineage.cmd1: Manual: follow every lineage link to its supporting primary source; record exact claim-to-section mapping. R-VOICE on touched proof routes.
p2_1_proof_lineage.red1: Provide a real citation that does not support its attributed claim: lineage review must reject the attribution.
p2_1_proof_lineage.c2: Example reproduces from the published instructions in a clean directory; actual output and limitations accompany the capability claim.
p2_1_proof_lineage.cmd2: R-SOURCE documented-example execution; R-SITE; R-CAPTURE on touched proof routes derived from the diff.
p2_1_proof_lineage.red2: Replace an input pin or expected output with a fictitious benchmark: reproduction/evidence comparison must fail.

p2_2_source_fidelity.inputs: transform-content mappings; all glossary/community sources and mirrors; contentSource.ts; docs_population
p2_2_source_fidelity.c1: Every glossary/community source and mirror has an owner and mapping decision; no unassigned rows, no registry synchronization.
p2_2_source_fidelity.cmd1: R-SOURCE; manual: enumerate both vault and site glossary/community files, then compare sets with transform mappings; stage provider gap request.
p2_2_source_fidelity.red1: Remove a mirror from the ledger: set reconciliation must detect the missing path.
p2_2_source_fidelity.c2: For each changed transform family, a disposable source change reaches corresponding HTML AND twin after rebuild; fixture assertions derive from the built snapshot.
p2_2_source_fidelity.cmd2: R-SITE and R-SOURCE in an isolated copy; record before/after source, HTML and twin hashes and changed text.
p2_2_source_fidelity.red2: Change source while freezing either output: family control must fail even when both old rendered outputs agree.

p2_3_docs_review.inputs: docs_population.json; twelve named tranche missions; source_fidelity_ledger; refreshed safe build
p2_3_docs_review.c1: All current content routes are assigned once to named tranches before their budgets are committed; other built routes have explicit existing mission owners.
p2_3_docs_review.cmd1: python3 how/campaigns/campaign_garnier/evidence/amendments/derive_docs_population.py; manual: compare the complete refreshed route/source/hash set with the ratification snapshot.
p2_3_docs_review.red1: Add or remove a route in a disposable inventory: completeness and assignment reconciliation must fail.
p2_3_docs_review.c2: No prose review is claimed by this coordinator; bounded source/read/work budgets and dependencies cover the entire corpus, with changed scope surfaced before tranche execution.
p2_3_docs_review.cmd2: Manual: reconcile every tranche route list and budget against docs_review_scope; python3 how/campaigns/campaign_garnier/evidence/genesis/derive_campaign.py.
p2_3_docs_review.red2: Mark an inventory-only row reviewed: reject closure evidence that has no page-reading record.

p2_4_trust_surfaces.inputs: people/lineage/state surfaces; policy pages; docs_population other_routes; consent records
p2_4_trust_surfaces.c1: Each decisive reader reaches people, lineage and current state from home within two links; exact links and destination headings are recorded.
p2_4_trust_surfaces.cmd1: Manual: start at / in a fresh preview, follow only visible links and record both clicks; R-CAPTURE trust/policy routes from other_routes.
p2_4_trust_surfaces.red1: Substitute an offsite logo destination for a state-of-network destination: path/task check must fail.
p2_4_trust_surfaces.c2: Dates, steward names, institutional relationships and held cards match source evidence at true strength; policy/twin disclosures survive revised navigation.
p2_4_trust_surfaces.cmd2: R-VOICE on touched trust/policy routes; R-SITE; compare institutional assertions to exact clearance conditions without modifying predecessor records.
p2_4_trust_surfaces.red2: Treat conditional H1 clearance as unconditional: clearance review must block that publication claim.

p2_5_midpoint.inputs: P0 baseline; P1/P2 evidence and every docs tranche AAR; two fixed exemplars
p2_5_midpoint.c1: Midpoint target and fixed exemplars use v1.1 and two isolated scorers; all dimension deltas, evidence ceilings and instrument changes are shown.
p2_5_midpoint.cmd1: Repeat P0.1 sealed-scoring protocol on frozen midpoint evidence; manual: compare clause rows and version hashes.
p2_5_midpoint.red1: Report a composite while withholding a dimension breakdown: score-pack review must reject it.
p2_5_midpoint.c2: Every P3-P6 mission has a retained/amended/deferred disposition and derived estimate; only P3 budget is committed at DP4, with later phases still provisional.
p2_5_midpoint.cmd2: python3 how/campaigns/campaign_garnier/evidence/genesis/derive_campaign.py; manual: reconcile mission dispositions and operator DP4 response.
p2_5_midpoint.red2: Carry forward a removed mission cost or mark DP4 accepted without a human event: budget/gate review must fail.

p3_1_design_system.inputs: ADR-053/059; WebForge wrapper; full tracked component/layout/page/style set; P1 storyboard
p3_1_design_system.c1: Component/type/token census covers the full declared tracked population and assigns every exception to a semantic reason; provider validators consume existing light/dark tokens.
p3_1_design_system.cmd1: R-TOKENS; manual: validate bundle against pinned provider schema and compare population with git ls-files; record schema argv at execution.
p3_1_design_system.red1: Omit a TSX island or bypass a semantic color token in a disposable component: population/token controls must fail.
p3_1_design_system.c2: Design-system page and one of each touched template show a consistent type/space hierarchy in both themes, with preserved contrast and focus.
p3_1_design_system.cmd2: R-SITE; R-CAPTURE on /design-system plus each changed template; python3 site/scripts/token_aa_check.py --json.
p3_1_design_system.red2: Remove a focus treatment or use a failing theme token pair: keyboard/contrast checks must fail.

p3_2_hero_slots.inputs: approved storyboard; five-slot ADR-053; cleared assets; VisualDNA consumer bundle
p3_2_hero_slots.c1: Every art asset belongs to an approved slot and has provenance, clearance/abstract-only generation classification and an alt/decorative decision.
p3_2_hero_slots.cmd1: Manual: enumerate actual slot imports and compare to asset ledger; generated art uses the approved provider guardrails only.
p3_2_hero_slots.red1: Add an unassigned sixth slot or synthetic institutional scene: slot/provenance review must reject it.
p3_2_hero_slots.c2: All slot-containing routes retain readable mechanism and actions with art disabled, at narrow widths and 200/400% reflow in both themes.
p3_2_hero_slots.cmd2: R-CAPTURE all slot routes; R-SITE; manual art-disabled and browser zoom inspection of the same text/action paths.
p3_2_hero_slots.red2: Hide a required command inside artwork: art-disabled task completion must fail.

p3_3_diagram_code.inputs: graph/keyboard twin; code components; all /vaults routes assigned by docs_population; diagram source data
p3_3_diagram_code.c1: Diagram semantics have a text/keyboard equivalent matching source nodes/edges; registry template labels are reviewed read-only, data corrections staged to Hestia.
p3_3_diagram_code.cmd1: Manual: compare source graph IDs/edges with visible keyboard twin; derive diagram/code instances from tracked source imports.
p3_3_diagram_code.red1: Drop a node from the keyboard twin: node-set comparison must fail.
p3_3_diagram_code.c2: Every executable code action copies the displayed runnable string; clipboard denial has accessible recovery, and code remains readable without page overflow.
p3_3_diagram_code.cmd2: R-SITE; R-CAPTURE /vaults/graph and code-bearing templates; manual keyboard traversal and clipboard success/rejection using disposable Playwright permissions.
p3_3_diagram_code.red2: Reject clipboard permission and inject an overlong unbroken command: absence of recovery or page-wide overflow must fail.

p3_4_motion_social.inputs: tracked motion/state inventory; OG generator and actual generated images; changed route types
p3_4_motion_social.c1: All discovered animation and interactive-state instances have normal/reduced-motion, keyboard, no-JS and error-state dispositions.
p3_4_motion_social.cmd1: Manual: enumerate tracked animation/listener/island imports; use R-CAPTURE with additional explicit normal-motion runs, since default captures reduce motion.
p3_4_motion_social.red1: Disable a request or motion preference path: missing recovery or reduced-motion parity must fail.
p3_4_motion_social.c2: Generated OG cards for every touched route class use correct title/identity, do not crop essential text and convey no unsupported claim.
p3_4_motion_social.cmd2: R-SITE; manual: follow each rendered og:image URL, inspect original image dimensions and social crop; compare title metadata with its page.
p3_4_motion_social.red2: Point a changed page at another title card: OG identity/crop review must fail.

p4_1_performance.inputs: five critical templates; pinned Lighthouse/provider bars; real collector receipt; field_performance_policy
p4_1_performance.c1: All ten mobile/desktop lab cases meet the referenced provider/consumer budgets, with exact tool/build pins and waterfall evidence.
p4_1_performance.cmd1: R-PERF; R-SITE; manual: reconcile ten expected route/device rows against actual reports; never equate TBT to INP.
p4_1_performance.red1: Add an oversized asset to a disposable candidate: payload/lab budget must fail.
p4_1_performance.c2: Field disposition differentiates measured failure, insufficient data and unverified collection; exception eligibility requires receipt and a dated follow-up plan.
p4_1_performance.cmd2: field_performance_policy decision procedure; R-PERF transport/collector verification.
p4_1_performance.red2: Remove receipt, remove sufficiency metadata, then inject a valid field failure: none may be reported field-green or qualify through the wrong branch.

p4_2_accessibility.inputs: changed templates and user flows; existing manual AA protocol; assistive-tech coverage
p4_2_accessibility.c1: Every expected route×viewport×theme axe row is reached, with zero violations; missing rows are failures.
p4_2_accessibility.cmd1: R-CAPTURE all changed template representatives plus seven first-contact routes; R-SITE.
p4_2_accessibility.red1: Omit mobile dark or inject a missing input label: coverage/axe checks must fail.
p4_2_accessibility.c2: Keyboard, zoom/reflow and manual assistive-tech flows preserve reading order, focus, labels, code recovery and equivalent diagram information.
p4_2_accessibility.cmd2: Manual protocol from doctrine_web_quality_assessment: navigate home→first task, search/docs, community proposal and graph keyboard twin; record AT/browser/version and actual observations.
p4_2_accessibility.red2: Place a focus trap or remove diagram text equivalent in a disposable page: manual task must identify the defect; automation alone cannot close the criterion.

p4_3_regression.inputs: final candidate tree; full gates and CI injections; all built routes; predecessor machine protections
p4_3_regression.c1: Fresh safe build, full gate suite, markup and pinned visual container pass with no new skips/xfails; all built routes have an owning disposition.
p4_3_regression.cmd1: R-SITE; from site/: /opt/homebrew/bin/bash scripts/visual_regression_container.sh check; compare full route manifest with docs_population rows and other_routes.
p4_3_regression.red1: Omit an injection in a disposable build or delete a twin: suite must fail for the intended missing surface.
p4_3_regression.c2: Machine/API/negotiation and source/slug/count specs match the candidate; existing live probes are labeled predecessor until separately published.
p4_3_regression.cmd2: R-MACHINE; manual: review git diff for changed route/count literals and matching specs, derive values from the same build snapshot.
p4_3_regression.red2: Give a probe a login/challenge page with HTTP 200: content/build identity assertions must reject it.

p5_1_human_panel.inputs: reader_protocol; frozen final build; operator-recruited consenting cold participants
p5_1_human_panel.c1: Predeclared cohort has at least five new humans per decisive class; consent-safe raw responses, timing and build identities accompany every score.
p5_1_human_panel.cmd1: reader_protocol stimulus/timing and final-panel sections; manual: reconcile participant records against the sealed roster and exclude formative participants.
p5_1_human_panel.red1: Replace a response with a synthetic one or mix build identities: panel integrity must fail.
p5_1_human_panel.c2: At least ceil(0.8*n) pass in EACH window for EACH class; every role task is satisfied and standing-reader regressions are dispositioned.
p5_1_human_panel.cmd2: reader_protocol answer key and retest rules; two scorers apply the sealed key before adjudicating disagreement; publish numerators/denominators, not only percentages.
p5_1_human_panel.red2: Use a plausible aspiration-as-fact answer and a pooled cross-version result: scoring must reject both; failed classes require new cold cohorts.

p5_2_rescore.inputs: final human panel; P0/midpoint packs; frozen candidate; HAUSSMANN boundary/GR-7
p5_2_rescore.c1: Final v1.1 score retains two independent sheets, target and both exemplar breakdowns, human evidence and all ceilings.
p5_2_rescore.cmd1: P0.1 sealed-scoring protocol on final pack; manual: reconcile every dimension and anchor against baseline/midpoint evidence.
p5_2_rescore.red1: Swap a local report for a deployed claim or omit a dimension: reconciliation must reject the conclusion.
p5_2_rescore.c2: Every protected invariant and S1/S2 finding has an evidence-backed disposition; integration handoff names candidate hash and remains staged for GR-7.
p5_2_rescore.cmd2: Manual: full reconciliation against haussmann_reconciliation_ledger and finding register; R-CLOSE; no peer/predecessor edits.
p5_2_rescore.red2: Remove a held G4/counsel item or assert a memo was delivered from a staged file: integration readiness must fail.

p5_3_publication.inputs: final candidate/CI/evidence identities; G4/counsel and predecessor holds; field disposition
p5_3_publication.c1: Release manifest matches exact candidate tree, applicable CI result, frozen evidence and consent/embargo dispositions; no unresolved measured field failure.
p5_3_publication.cmd1: git rev-parse HEAD; gh run list --branch main --limit 1 --json headSha,conclusion; manual: match candidate-specific CI, not merely latest green; field_performance_policy.
p5_3_publication.red1: Present green CI from an older tree as candidate verification: release identity review must fail.
p5_3_publication.c2: Decision artifact separates push, deploy, peer delivery and any insufficient-data exception; exception has collector proof and launch+30-day review owner.
p5_3_publication.cmd2: Manual: render the existing ISS gate with explicit action scopes and read actual operator response; this mission prepares the decision and does not deploy.
p5_3_publication.red2: Use DP1 approval as deploy authority or missing collector receipt as low traffic: gate authority/exception review must reject it.

p6_1_campaign_aar.inputs: rolling closure ledger; mission AARs; baseline/midpoint/final scorecards; session actuals
p6_1_campaign_aar.c1: Full/light AAR reconcile each mission objective and failure to its evidence, including the original genesis overstatement and instrument drift.
p6_1_campaign_aar.cmd1: Manual: join mission IDs and objective IDs against rolling_closure_ledger and actual AARs; read every unmatched row.
p6_1_campaign_aar.red1: Remove a failed attempt from the AAR while retaining only the passing rerun: audit must detect loss of history.
p6_1_campaign_aar.c2: Estimate/actual totals derive from content-load session records; billing is separate and unavailable where no measurement exists.
p6_1_campaign_aar.cmd2: python3 how/campaigns/campaign_garnier/evidence/genesis/derive_campaign.py; manual: sum session actuals with uncertainty, list missing measurements separately.
p6_1_campaign_aar.red2: Treat unknown billing/calibration as zero or mix cache-read billing into content-load: unit reconciliation must fail.

p6_2_decadal_aar.inputs: all reviewer files; canonical adopter ranker; final evidence/limitations; skill_decadal_aar
p6_2_decadal_aar.c1: Every one of the sixteen existing lenses has an evidence-backed finding/disposition, with any unavailable perspective explicitly owed.
p6_2_decadal_aar.cmd1: Manual protocol: skill_decadal_aar reviewer lens pass using the actual roster; preserve each lens output and evidence.
p6_2_decadal_aar.red1: Drop a reviewer or invent a human quotation: roster/provenance audit must fail.
p6_2_decadal_aar.c2: Canonical adopter capstone uses its existing aggregation and target ≥4.95; parallel reviewer dimensions and disagreements remain separate.
p6_2_decadal_aar.cmd2: Manual: recompute the canonical ranker from individual sheets and compare to reported score; do not add GARNIER diagnostic totals.
p6_2_decadal_aar.red2: Average a parallel reviewer score into the canonical ranker: arithmetic/provenance check must reject it.

p6_3_graduation.inputs: rolling learnings; existing context/doctrine/skill inventory; skill_context_graduation
p6_3_graduation.c1: Every proposed graduation cites reusable evidence and existing owner/location; provider-owned patterns remain staged contributions.
p6_3_graduation.cmd1: Manual protocol: skill_context_graduation rubric per candidate; inspect target content before writing and link supporting missions.
p6_3_graduation.red1: Promote a single unexplained anecdote as established doctrine: graduation rubric must reject it.
p6_3_graduation.c2: Local approved additions resolve through their own indices, have metadata and related links; standard/template changes remain a separate upstream gate.
p6_3_graduation.cmd2: Manual: follow all new index links and review explicit-path diff against Rule 10 and .adna exclusion; R-CLOSE.
p6_3_graduation.red2: Include a provider file or .adna change in a disposable diff: scope audit must reject it.

p6_4_graph_updates.inputs: graph_update_plan; rolling learnings; every patterns_to_author row; peer owner routing
p6_4_graph_updates.c1: Every required graph has concrete learning/change or evidenced no-change disposition, owner persona, authority and proposed destination.
p6_4_graph_updates.cmd1: Manual: reconcile graph_update_plan graph set and all mission patterns_to_author entries with the ledger, including author persona versus vault address.
p6_4_graph_updates.red1: Omit Canvas or an unfulfilled provider pattern: graph/set reconciliation must fail.
p6_4_graph_updates.c2: Every memo stays staged in aDNA.aDNA with supersession condition and actionable artifact reference; no peer write or claimed delivery occurs.
p6_4_graph_updates.cmd2: R-CLOSE; manual: inspect memo status, destination, pinned facts, supersession condition and accessible payload.
p6_4_graph_updates.red2: Mark an unsent memo delivered or cite a machine-local nonexistent attachment: delivery/actionability review must fail.

p6_5_followup.inputs: open findings/holds; launch date if any; field_performance_policy; VITRUVIUS cadence
p6_5_followup.c1: Every unresolved item has owner, next evidence event and completion criterion; field reviews occur launch+30 days and monthly until sufficient.
p6_5_followup.cmd1: Manual: reconcile open finding IDs, held memos and field dispositions against followup_scope; derive dates from the actual launch date.
p6_5_followup.red1: Use the planned launch date when no launch occurred: cadence review must keep the trigger pending.
p6_5_followup.c2: Full instrument every two quarters, monthly claim/link review and TTFS on quickstart releases are assigned; no scheduler or outbound message is silently installed.
p6_5_followup.cmd2: Manual: compare review_cadence with VITRUVIUS §10 and field policy, then inspect the actual diff for unauthorized automation.
p6_5_followup.red2: Omit TTFS on a quickstart release or assert an uninstalled schedule is active: cadence status check must fail.

p6_6_close.inputs: all P6 deliverables; operator DP8 response; held follow-ups; close splash template
p6_6_close.c1: Close packet contains full/light AAR, sixteen-lens pass, graduation and every graph-update disposition, including explicitly retained obligations.
p6_6_close.cmd1: Manual: reconcile the P6 output contract with actual artifacts and unresolved follow-up IDs; R-CLOSE.
p6_6_close.red1: Hide an unresolved peer delivery by calling the campaign complete: completion review must reject it.
p6_6_close.c2: Campaign completed status requires actual DP8 approval; STATE and current pointer agree with the ruled next action.
p6_6_close.cmd2: Manual: compare operator event, §7.7 record, campaign status and STATE after ratification; retain all prior decisions in history.
p6_6_close.red2: Set completed with DP8 still pending: authority/status review must fail.

p2_3_t01_docs_review.inputs: docs_population T01; exact source/HTML/twin rows; source_fidelity_ledger
p2_3_t01_docs_review.c1: Read every assigned source and rendered article in T01; record each claim/instruction finding and reviewed disposition, with no uninspected row marked reviewed.
p2_3_t01_docs_review.cmd1: R-SOURCE for exactly /learn/course/four-files-your-agent-reads-first,/learn/course/what-is-an-adna-graph,/how/lattice-examples/lattice-campaign-execution,/how/lattice-examples/lattice-content-pipeline,/how/lattice-examples/lattice-context-serving,/how/lattice-examples/lattice-dual-audience-review,/how/publishing/content-mapping,/how/publishing/social-sharing,/how/publishing/vault-to-site,/how/workshops/build-your-first-vault,/how/workshops/facilitation-guide,/how/workshops/lattice-design,/how/workshops/vault-exploration,/learn/tutorials/build-a-lattice; manually follow every normative/lineage citation and record reached sections.
p2_3_t01_docs_review.red1: Remove one T01 route from the review ledger or preserve only its title: coverage/read-evidence reconciliation must fail.
p2_3_t01_docs_review.c2: Every correction in T01 survives source regeneration and safe build, agrees with its twin and has an executed local example or explicitly held external step.
p2_3_t01_docs_review.cmd2: R-SITE; R-SOURCE execution/fidelity protocol; R-CAPTURE all changed routes in T01.
p2_3_t01_docs_review.red2: Seed an obsolete local command and stale twin in disposable copies: execution or fidelity checks must identify both by route.

p2_3_t02_docs_review.inputs: docs_population T02; exact source/HTML/twin rows; source_fidelity_ledger
p2_3_t02_docs_review.c1: Read every assigned source and rendered article in T02; record each claim/instruction finding and reviewed disposition, with no uninspected row marked reviewed.
p2_3_t02_docs_review.cmd1: R-SOURCE for exactly /learn/tutorials/design-a-mission,/learn/tutorials/exchange-adoption-path,/learn/tutorials/extend-the-ontology,/learn/tutorials/federate-a-vault,/learn/tutorials/first-claude-md,/learn/tutorials/navigate-a-vault,/learn/tutorials/question-test,/learn/tutorials/run-a-campaign,/learn/tutorials/write-a-context-file,/community/proposals/aep-1,/community/proposals/aep-2,/reference/specification/1-introduction-scope,/reference/specification/10-context-library,/reference/specification/11-coordination-protocol,/reference/specification/12-template-system; manually follow every normative/lineage citation and record reached sections.
p2_3_t02_docs_review.red1: Remove one T02 route from the review ledger or preserve only its title: coverage/read-evidence reconciliation must fail.
p2_3_t02_docs_review.c2: Every correction in T02 survives source regeneration and safe build, agrees with its twin and has an executed local example or explicitly held external step.
p2_3_t02_docs_review.cmd2: R-SITE; R-SOURCE execution/fidelity protocol; R-CAPTURE all changed routes in T02.
